description: Reti elettriche is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices3.civis.bz.it. Reti elettriche (Rete ad alta, media e bassa tensione). Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Reti elettriche, Stromleitungen. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
